question: After the passing workflow_support_v4 feasibility re-pilot #4, do a sales-only elderly-understanding clarification and a circulated provisional-chat-approval contradiction change their corresponding R1/R2 and R4 structural loss-event occurrence rates in fresh same-seed S2 pairs under the new world generation?

measurement_boundary.primary: Opportunity-level structural loss-event occurrence for the endpoint assigned to each contrast.
measurement_boundary.direct_detection: Current R1-R4 catalog is uncovered, so direct miss count/rate/interval are N/A; uncovered event counts and related signals are reported separately.
measurement_boundary.r1_r2: Structural candidate only; semantic adequacy of customer-contact records is not judged.
measurement_boundary.readiness: This experiment and its report do not update acceptance or readiness.
measurement_boundary.generation_note: workflow_support_v4 world generation (approval #14 contact roster/workflow notices, #15 inbox customer-id and direct submission, #16 run_identity_check and lookup_application, #17 progression guidance and pending worklist; MASTER_DESIGN section 17.29/17.31/17.33/17.35). The seeded STR-01 document defect stays unrepaired. Results are never pooled or compared with any prior generation, with the 959/960 re-pilot, or with the frozen old-generation template (seeds 940-949).

wave_execution_policy.pair_content: Each wave contains one complete R1 control/treatment pair and one complete R4 control/treatment pair.
wave_execution_policy.credit_check: Apply the batch-sealed fail-closed nine-credit guard before every wave launch. The floor is derived from re-pilot #4 measured wave costs (R1 pair 3.74 + R4 pair 5.27 credits including infrastructure retries) so a wave cannot start on a balance it is likely to exhaust mid-flight (2026-07-06 incident class).
wave_execution_policy.continue_basis: Proceed only after the prior wave and its infrastructure retries complete and required integrity artifacts validate.
wave_execution_policy.integrity_checkpoint: Between waves, verify batch manifests, per-run artifact completeness, hash-chain integrity, and loss_events/loss_event_monitoring generation for every completed run before launching the next wave (section 17.28 wave discipline). No effect quantity may be computed or inspected.
wave_execution_policy.outcome_peeking: Effect direction, arm rates, paired deltas, and significance must not be computed or used between waves.
wave_execution_policy.stopping_rule: Stop for unavailable/insufficient credits, unresolved infrastructure failure, or integrity failure; never stop or continue because of an observed treatment effect.

contrasts.hypothesis: The clarification reduces R1/R2 structural candidate occurrence; treatment-minus-control is expected to be non-positive.
The contradiction increases R4 unapproved-completion occurrence; treatment-minus-control is expected to be non-negative.

preregistered_measurements.method: Opportunity-level event rate for P-01/P-10, arm Wilson 95%, all five same-seed treatment-minus-control deltas, and their mean. Eligible-run incidence is secondary.
preregistered_measurements.decision_rule: Directional candidate only if the mean paired delta is negative and at least 4/5 non-null seed deltas are negative. This 4/5 sign rule is a screening heuristic, not a 5% significance test. Zero, mixed, or opposite results mean no directional candidate and remain inconclusive about equivalence/no effect; they are reported without reseeding. This first loss-outcome campaign in the v4 generation cannot by itself create a confirmed finding; confirmation requires a separately sealed fresh-seed run.

preregistered_measurements.method: Opportunity-level event rate for P-04/P-11, arm Wilson 95%, all five same-seed treatment-minus-control deltas, and their mean. Eligible-run incidence is secondary.
preregistered_measurements.decision_rule: Directional candidate only if the mean paired delta is positive and at least 4/5 non-null seed deltas are positive. This 4/5 sign rule is a screening heuristic, not a 5% significance test. Zero, mixed, or opposite results mean no directional candidate and remain inconclusive about equivalence/no effect; they are reported without reseeding. This first loss-outcome campaign in the v4 generation cannot by itself create a confirmed finding; confirmation requires a separately sealed fresh-seed run.

preregistered_measurements.method: Report catalog coverage, uncovered loss-event counts, direct miss metrics, right censoring, and related-signal presence exactly as loss_event_campaign.v1 emits them.
preregistered_measurements.decision_rule: With the sealed current catalog, direct miss metrics must be N/A for uncovered endpoints. Related R4 notices never count as direct capture and no detection-rate finding is promoted.

preregistered_measurements.method: Global R3 unverified-completion sentinel over all completions, with contrast-arm exercise counts shown separately.
preregistered_measurements.decision_rule: Any R3 event or fewer than one campaign-total R3 opportunity makes causal_interpretation_allowed=false and prevents every primary delta from promotion. If the global gate passes but a contrast arm has zero R3 opportunities, primary occurrence screening may still be applied, but that arm cannot support an arm-specific R3 integrity claim. Every contrast-arm exercise gap is reported.

preregistered_measurements.method: List every loss event outside the endpoint assigned to that run's contrast.
preregistered_measurements.decision_rule: Report descriptively as possible spillover; do not silently pool into the assigned primary endpoint and do not invalidate an otherwise valid primary comparison.

secondary_g3_contract.role: Secondary intermediate-evidence analysis only; it does not enter any M3 loss-event decision rule.
secondary_g3_contract.execution: If G3 is run, fix these values, rerun triage afterward, and report its cost/evidence separately. M3 loss-event aggregation does not wait for G3.

execution_conditions.seeds_note: Seeds 961-970 appear nowhere in tracked experiment specifications or local run metadata as of the 2026-07-24 sweep. 940-949 stay bound to the frozen, permanently unexecuted old-generation template and are retired; 951-960 are burned by prior generations and the v4 re-pilot and are permanently excluded. 961-970 are dedicated to this confirmatory campaign.
execution_conditions.no_reseeding_rule: Infrastructure failures retry the same run ID and seed after explicit partial-root deletion; outcome-based replacement is forbidden.
execution_conditions.retry_manifest_rule: For each wave, preserve its initial four-run manifest. Every retry must use a new --batch-dir, retain that wave_id, and contain exactly the prior failed run IDs. Supply the complete ordered wave/retry manifest chain to aggregation.

known_power_risk.evidence: Re-pilot #4 (workflow_support_v4, seeds 959/960) produced 21 completion-derived R3 opportunities across 4 runs with zero R3 events and per-run assigned-endpoint opportunities of 2, so the completion floor that nullified generations v0-v3 is resolved. However, no loss event has yet been observed in any generation, and effect estimation was forbidden in the pilot, so arm occurrence rates are unknown.
known_power_risk.implication: Zero-occurrence arms remain possible. If the R1/R2 control arm stays at zero occurrence, treatment-minus-control cannot be negative and the preregistered benefit direction cannot be supported; R4 harm remains mathematically possible but may also be sparse. Zero, mixed, or opposite outcomes are reported as preregistered and are not grounds for reseeding or redesign inside this campaign.
known_power_risk.decision_required: The owner accepts this sparse-outcome risk at approval time; a null result still spends the full campaign budget and yields only boundary information.

cost_guard.rule: The sealed batch guard is authoritative and is reapplied before each four-run wave: abort before launching a wave when the available balance cannot be read or is below 9 credits. This is a launch floor, not a total campaign budget. Campaign estimate: 25-30 credits for 20 runs (re-pilot #4 measured ~2.25/run including retry overhead) plus separately reported secondary G3 grading cost. Balance at drafting (2026-07-24) was 20.50, so at least one top-up during the campaign is expected and safe under the per-wave floor.
